status_code_data.description: The HTTP 308 Permanent Redirect redirection response status code indicates that the requested resource has been permanently moved to the URL given by the Location header.

meme_data.description: The Backrooms is a creepypasta inspired by a comment on a picture of an "unsettling room" on 4chan's /x/ board. The creepypasta states that if one is not careful and "noclips out of reality in the wrong areas", they will end up in the Backrooms.
